## What this region is

How a developer or agent brings the template up on a machine and keeps it runnable: per-developer setup, the local run loop on Docker services, and isolated worktrees with their own databases, buckets and ports.

## What it exists for

- Set up a fresh clone or provision a new fork
- Start, reset or seed the local database
- Run the app locally (whole stack or one app)
- Create local object-storage buckets
- Work on a branch in an isolated worktree
- Decide where scripts and scratch files go

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Only do this in prod → environments-deploy
- Start the api in production → dx-tools
- Where do I read the project config in init → init-architecture
- Get my schema change into the database → database-tooling
- How do I test this route → test-harness
